thread:
luca: CI red on master, looks like a burst of session-store failures in the last 3 runs. job: https://ci.redwood.example/job/2005554321
ci-bot: build 2005554321 failed — 14 tests failed in //services/session-store:unit (flake count: 3)
luca: failing tests are all around session expiry / redis eviction timing, stacktrace points at SessionCacheTest.testTtlExpiry
anya: saw something similar yesterday locally, rerun passed for me once, flaky rather than deterministic
natalie: I pulled the logs from the mock-redis container — seeing lots of eviction warnings: "evicting key due to maxmemory-policy" and keys TTLs being set to very short windows
sam: tagging @devops-maya — any infra changes to mock-redis config in CI recently?
devops-maya: not in infra config, but there was a PR that updated the test-suite's docker image which bumped redis image to 6.2.6 -> 7.0.2 last week. Could be different eviction defaults
anya: that would do it. tests rely on predictable TTL semantics, upgrading redis can change eviction heuristics under memory pressure
luca: adding the failing snippet for context:
```
org.junit.ComparisonFailure: expected:<true> but was:<false>
 at SessionCacheTest.testTtlExpiry(SessionCacheTest.java:87)
 at ...
Caused by: java.lang.IllegalStateException: session not found (expired)
```
natalie: interim fix: we can pin the mock-redis container to the older image version in CI or set `maxmemory-policy noeviction` in the compose file for the test env
sam: or tweak tests to be more tolerant (increase TTLs / retries). But pinning image is quickest to get master green
luca: can someone triage and either rerun or apply the pin? I don't want to ship a skip unless necessary
devops-maya: I can spin up a CI patch this morning to set `maxmemory-policy noeviction` in the test compose and trigger a rerun. Will post the patch link here
ci-bot: rebuild requested by devops-maya — queued as 2005554322
anya: if the rerun passes, let's open a follow-up to either make the tests resilient or add an explicit env var in CI to control redis policy per suite
natalie: created issue #4523: "session-store flake: redis eviction differences across image versions" — assigned to eng-platform for follow-up
sam: quick bisect request: can someone check which PR bumped the docker image? I can start local repro against 7.0.2 if needed
devops-maya: found PR #3487 bumped base images. I'll add a revert/patch to CI for the session-test job and force a rerun now
oncall-bot: Reminder: if CI remains red for >30m, trigger oncall rotation per playbook
luca: thanks — will wait for rerun result. if still red we'll schedule a short bisect window and push a temporary pin on master
ci-bot: build 2005554322 passed (session-store failures cleared) — rerun logs: eviction policy change applied in test compose
luca: great, thanks @devops-maya and team. Follow-up actions: (1) PR to make tests tolerant / remove reliance on eviction heuristics (2) decide whether to pin redis image or explicitly set policy in our CI images — will coordinate on the issue assigned to eng-platform
anya: and add a note in the release checklist about base-image bumps impacting infra semantics
natalie: copying that to the retro notes. closing thread once issue #4523 has a proposed fix
